papers.title: Soil-transmitted helminth reinfection after anthelmintic treatment in schools with improved versus unimproved WASH infrastructure in Mozambique: a prospective cohort study.
papers.translated_title: 莫桑比克改善与未改善WASH基础设施学校中驱虫治疗后土壤传播蠕虫再感染情况：一项前瞻性队列研究。
papers.author: Novela, V.
papers.summary: Background Soil-transmitted helminths (STH) infect more than a billion people worldwide, disproportionately affecting communities with poor water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH). Mass drug administration is the primary control strategy, but reinfection frequently occurs within months of treatment, and the extent to which improved WASH reduces reinfection risk remains unclear. We conducted a prospective cohort study comparing STH reinfection rates over seven months after anthelmintic treatment among school-aged children attending schools with improved versus unimproved WASH in the Manhica district, Mozambique, using reinfection dynamics as a proxy for the impact of WASH interventions. Methods Children were screened for STH using Kato-Katz microscopy, then dewormed with albendazole and praziquantel (plus ivermectin for those positive for T. trichiura and/or S. stercoralis). A follow-up sample was collected 21 days post-treatment from initially positive children to assess the cure rate (CR) and egg reduction rate (ERR). Cured participants were enrolled in the WASH-improved or WASH-unimproved cohort and followed monthly for seven months. Reinfection and incidence rates were estimated, and Cox proportional hazards regression was used to assess the association between WASH cohort and time to reinfection. Results STH prevalence was 17.5% (95% CI: 15.2-19.8; n=178/1018), comprising T. trichiura (9.5%), A. lumbricoides (6.3%), S. stercoralis (2.6%), and hookworms (1.9%). No heavy-intensity infections were observed; most T. trichiura (94.9%) and hookworm (94.7%) infections were light, whereas 43.8% of A. lumbricoides infections were moderate. CR/ERR were 88.4%/96.56% for T. trichiura (n=95) and 93.3%/93.36% for A. lumbricoides (n=50). Overall reinfection rate was 32.3% (n=54/167), higher in the improved-WASH cohort (39.3%) than in the unimproved-WASH cohort (18.2%), corresponding to 66.38 reinfections per 1,000 person-months at risk overall (82.27 vs. 35.89 by cohort). The unimproved-WASH cohort had a lower hazard of reinfection (HR=0.456; 95% CI: 0.229-0.908; p=0.0254). Conclusions Despite effective treatment, over a third of children were reinfected within seven months, with reinfection unexpectedly higher in the improved-WASH cohort. This suggests that infrastructure-based WASH classification may not capture true exposure or behavioural risk, underscoring the need for household-level monitoring to assess WASH impact alongside MDA.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 土壤传播蠕虫（STH）感染全球超过十亿人，对水资源、环境卫生和个人卫生（WASH）条件较差的社区影响尤为严重。大规模药物管理是主要控制策略，但治疗后的数月内常发生再感染，而改善WASH在多大程度上降低再感染风险仍不明确。我们在莫桑比克曼希卡区开展了一项前瞻性队列研究，比较学龄儿童在驱虫治疗后七个月内的STH再感染率，研究对象就读于WASH条件改善与未改善的学校，以再感染动态作为WASH干预效果的代理指标。方法 使用Kato-Katz显微镜检查筛查儿童STH感染，随后使用阿苯达唑和吡喹酮进行驱虫治疗（对鞭虫和/或粪类圆线虫阳性者加用伊维菌素）。治疗后第21天对初始阳性儿童采集随访样本，以评估治愈率（CR）和虫卵减少率（ERR）。治愈参与者被纳入WASH改善或WASH未改善队列，并每月随访七个月。估算再感染率和发病率，使用Cox比例风险回归评估WASH队列与再感染时间之间的关联。结果 STH患病率为17.5%（95% CI：15.2-19.8；n=178/1018），包括鞭虫（9.5%）、蛔虫（6.3%）、粪类圆线虫（2.6%）和钩虫（1.9%）。未观察到重度感染；大多数鞭虫（94.9%）和钩虫（94.7%）感染为轻度，而43.8%的蛔虫感染为中度。鞭虫的CR/ERR为88.4%/96.56%（n=95），蛔虫为93.3%/93.36%（n=50）。总体再感染率为32.3%（n=54/167），WASH改善队列（39.3%）高于WASH未改善队列（18.2%），对应总体每1000人月风险中66.38例再感染（两队列分别为82.27 vs. 35.89）。WASH未改善队列的再感染风险较低（HR=0.456；95% CI：0.229-0.908；p=0.0254）。结论 尽管治疗有效，超过三分之一的儿童在七个月内发生再感染，且WASH改善队列的再感染率意外更高。这表明基于基础设施的WASH分类可能无法捕捉真实暴露或行为风险，强调在MDA之外需进行家庭层面监测以评估WASH影响。

papers.title: Divergent genetic mediator signatures of adiposity-related metabolic liabilities and coronary artery disease.
papers.translated_title: 肥胖相关代谢风险与冠状动脉疾病的分歧性遗传中介特征。
papers.author: SIMON CAMPOS, J. A.
papers.summary: Background. Obesity and leanness lie at opposite ends of the weight spectrum, yet both carry coronary risk when metabolically dysfunctional. A 2025 Commission redefined obesity around organ function rather than body mass, but whether that distinction reflects a difference in causal architecture, and whether the two high-risk phenotypes reach disease by distinct routes, is untested. Methods. We conducted two-sample Mendelian randomization of the four combinations of adiposity and metabolic health against coronary artery disease (CARDIoGRAMplusC4D; 60,801 cases), using published adiposity and insulin-resistance instruments. Thirty mediators were interrogated identically in every quadrant by two-step Mendelian randomization with multivariable adjustment, and the pipeline replicated with an independent instrument sharing five of fifty-three variants. Results. Adiposity with preserved metabolic function was protective (odds ratio 0.28, 95% CI 0.19?0.42), whereas adiposity with metabolic dysfunction (1.90, 1.42?2.55) and leanness with metabolic dysfunction (1.86, 1.52?2.27) conferred indistinguishable risk (ratio of odds ratios 1.02; P = 0.91). The unhealthy obese phenotype acted through triglycerides and diabetes; the unhealthy lean through apolipoprotein B, blood pressure and diabetes, sharing no other conduit. High-density lipoprotein cholesterol and triglycerides collapsed despite being the most strongly instrumented exposures, indicating causal redundancy rather than weak-instrument bias. Conclusions. Coronary risk follows the failure of adipose storage capacity, not its magnitude. The two high-risk phenotypes reach the same endpoint by divergent causal architectures that reproduce in full with an independent instrument, and the metabolically unhealthy lean phenotype carries risk equal to clinical obesity while falling outside a framework that requires excess adiposity to be confirmed first.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。肥胖与消瘦处于体重谱的两端，但两者在代谢功能失调时均携带冠状动脉风险。2025年委员会将肥胖重新定义为围绕器官功能而非体质量，但这一区分是否反映因果结构上的差异，以及两种高风险表型是否通过不同途径导致疾病，尚未得到检验。方法。我们利用已发表的肥胖和胰岛素抵抗工具变量，对脂肪量和代谢健康的四种组合与冠状动脉疾病（CARDIoGRAMplusC4D；60,801例）进行了双样本孟德尔随机化分析。三十种中介因素在每个象限中均通过两步孟德尔随机化结合多变量调整进行相同检验，并使用一个共享53个变异中5个的独立工具变量复制了整个流程。结果。代谢功能保留的脂肪量具有保护作用（比值比0.28，95%置信区间0.19至0.42），而代谢功能失调的脂肪量（1.90，1.42至2.55）和代谢功能失调的消瘦（1.86，1.52至2.27）所携带的风险无法区分（比值比之比1.02；P = 0.91）。不健康肥胖表型通过甘油三酯和糖尿病起作用；不健康消瘦表型通过载脂蛋白B、血压和糖尿病起作用，两者无其他共同通路。高密度脂蛋白胆固醇和甘油三酯尽管是工具变量强度最高的暴露因素，却发生塌缩，表明存在因果冗余而非弱工具偏倚。结论。冠状动脉风险取决于脂肪储存能力的衰竭，而非其体量大小。两种高风险表型通过不同的因果结构达到相同终点，该结构在独立工具变量下完全复制，且代谢不健康消瘦表型所携带的风险与临床肥胖相当，却落在需先确认脂肪过多的框架之外。

papers.title: Genetically predicted expression of cuproptosis and copper-transport genes and coronary artery disease risk: a cis-Mendelian randomization and colocalization study
papers.translated_title: 基因预测的铜死亡及铜转运基因表达与冠状动脉疾病风险：一项顺式孟德尔随机化和共定位研究
papers.author: Guan, W.
papers.summary: Background. Cuproptosis, a copper-dependent form of regulated cell death, has been repeatedly reported to be transcriptionally activated in atherosclerotic plaque, and cuproptosis- and copper-transport genes have been nominated as candidate biomarkers and therapeutic targets on the basis of descriptive expression studies. Whether genetically determined expression of these genes is causally related to atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease has not been tested. Methods. We first confirmed, across two independent carotid plaque transcriptomic cohorts (GSE43292 and GSE28829), that a panel of copper-metabolism and cuproptosis genes is concordantly dysregulated in plaque and that the copper importers track the degree of inflammatory-cell infiltration. We then performed two-sample cis-Mendelian randomization (MR) and Bayesian colocalization to test the causal effect of the genetically predicted expression of 11 cuproptosis/copper genes on coronary artery disease (CAD). Instruments were cis-eQTLs from whole-blood (eQTLGen, n = 31,684) and tibial artery (GTEx v8, n = 584); the outcome was CAD (CARDIoGRAMplusC4D/Aragam 2022; 181,522 cases, 1,165,690 participants, European ancestry). Large-artery atherosclerotic stroke (GIGASTROKE) was examined as a secondary outcome. LPL served as a positive control. The positive control was intended to validate the direction and harmonization of the MR pipeline, not to demonstrate that single-causal-variant colocalization must succeed at a known multi-signal locus such as LPL. Results. In plaque, copper-import genes (SLC31A2, SLC31A1) were upregulated and correlated strongly with myeloid/inflammatory infiltration (SLC31A2 vs. M1-macrophage r = +0.87), whereas the exporter ATP7B correlated inversely (r = -0.73). The positive control LPL showed the expected robust protective effect on CAD (IVW OR 0.90 per SD higher expression, 95% CI 0.87-0.93, P = 4.1 x 10-12), validating the pipeline. None of the 11 cuproptosis/copper genes showed colocalization-supported causal evidence for CAD. Two genes reached nominal MR significance in single-instrument analyses (MTF1 OR 1.16, P = 2.7 x 10-3, DLAT OR 1.41, P = 2.2 x 10-3,) but were not supported by colocalization (MTF1 PP.H4 = 4 x 10-6 with PP.H3 = 0.9998; DLAT PP.H4 = 0.29), indicating linkage-disequilibrium confounding rather than causality. For well-instrumented genes (e.g. ATP7B, SLC31A2, FDX1), estimates were null and precise enough to exclude odds ratios larger than {approx}1.05 per SD. Conclusions. Common cis-regulatory variation determining the baseline expression of cuproptosis/copper-transport genes in available eQTL tissues did not support a detectable causal effect on CAD risk. This does not exclude locally acquired plaque cuproptosis; rather, the reported upregulation of these genes in plaque is most consistent with a consequence or marker of established disease rather than a germline-encoded causal driver, and cautions against target nomination based on descriptive transcriptomics alone. Keywords: cuproptosis; atherosclerosis; coronary artery disease; Mendelian randomization; colocalization
papers.translated_summary: 背景。铜死亡是一种铜依赖性的程序性细胞死亡形式，已有多次报道称其在动脉粥样硬化斑块中被转录激活，且铜死亡和铜转运相关基因基于描述性表达研究被提名为候选生物标志物和治疗靶点。然而，这些基因的遗传决定表达是否与动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病存在因果关系尚未得到验证。方法。我们首先在两个独立的颈动脉斑块转录组队列（GSE43292和GSE28829）中确认，一组铜代谢和铜死亡基因在斑块中呈现一致的失调表达，且铜摄入转运体与炎症细胞浸润程度相关。随后，我们进行了双样本顺式孟德尔随机化（MR）和贝叶斯共定位分析，以检验11个铜死亡/铜相关基因的遗传预测表达对冠状动脉疾病（CAD）的因果效应。工具变量来自全血（eQTLGen，n = 31,684）和胫骨动脉（GTEx v8，n = 584）的顺式eQTL；结局为CAD（CARDIoGRAMplusC4D/Aragam 2022；181,522例病例，1,165,690名参与者，欧洲血统）。大动脉粥样硬化性卒中（GIGASTROKE）作为次要结局进行检验。LPL作为阳性对照。阳性对照旨在验证MR流程的方向和协调性，而非证明单因果变异共定位必须在已知的多信号位点（如LPL）成功。结果。在斑块中，铜摄入基因（SLC31A2、SLC31A1）上调，并与髓系/炎症浸润密切相关（SLC31A2与M1型巨噬细胞r = +0.87），而外排转运体ATP7B则呈负相关（r = -0.73）。阳性对照LPL对CAD显示出预期的强保护效应（IVW OR 0.90，每SD表达升高，95% CI 0.87-0.93，P = 4.1 x 10-12），验证了流程的有效性。11个铜死亡/铜相关基因中，无一显示出共定位支持的CAD因果证据。两个基因在单工具变量分析中达到名义MR显著性（MTF1 OR 1.16，P = 2.7 x 10-3；DLAT OR 1.41，P = 2.2 x 10-3），但未获共定位支持（MTF1 PP.H4 = 4 x 10-6，PP.H3 = 0.9998；DLAT PP.H4 = 0.29），表明存在连锁不平衡混杂而非因果关系。对于工具变量充分的基因（如ATP7B、SLC31A2、FDX1），估计值为零且精度足以排除比值比大于约1.05每SD。结论。在现有eQTL组织中，决定铜死亡/铜转运基因基线表达的常见顺式调控变异未支持其对CAD风险存在可检测的因果效应。这并不排除局部获得的斑块铜死亡；相反，这些基因在斑块中报告的上调最符合既定疾病的后果或标志物，而非种系编码的因果驱动因素，并提醒不应仅基于描述性转录组学进行靶点提名。关键词：铜死亡；动脉粥样硬化；冠状动脉疾病；孟德尔随机化；共定位

papers.title: Abdominal Adiposity and Lacunar Stroke: A Mendelian Randomization Mediation Study
papers.translated_title: 腹部肥胖与腔隙性脑卒中：一项孟德尔随机化中介研究
papers.author: Guo, M.
papers.summary: Background: Lacunar stroke accounts for approximately 25% of ischaemic strokes and is linked to metabolic and vascular risk factors. Abdominal adiposity, measured as waist-to-hip ratio adjusted for BMI (WHRadjBMI), is a heritable predictor of cerebrovascular disease independent of overall adiposity, but its biological mediators remain unclear. We performed a two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) mediation analysis of 16 candidate biomarkers. Methods: Summary-level GWAS data were obtained from the IEU Open GWAS and EBI GWAS Catalog for WHRadjBMI (exposure), 16 mediators, and lacunar stroke (outcome). Instruments met genome-wide significance (P < 5 x 10), LD clumping (r2 < 0.001, 10,000 kb; 1000 Genomes European panel), and F-statistic 10. Inverse variance weighted regression was the primary analysis, with MR-Egger, weighted median, and MR-PRESSO sensitivity analyses. Mediation was quantified using the product-of-coefficients method with delta-method standard errors. Results: Systolic blood pressure showed the largest mediation proportion (29.6%; 95% CI, 12.7%-46.5%), followed by diastolic blood pressure (29.2%; 12.1%-46.3%) and glycated hemoglobin (23.0%; 11.2% to 57.2%). Other mediators included triglycerides (10.8%), fasting insulin (9.9%), blood glucose (7.0%), HDL cholesterol (3.2%), and LDL cholesterol (1.1%). Sensitivity analyses were generally consistent, though MR-Egger intercepts suggested directional pleiotropy for glycoprotein acetyls and CRP (Path A only). Because mediators are intercorrelated, proportions cannot be summed; multivariable MR is needed for joint effects. The HbA1c estimate was imprecise and requires cautious interpretation. Conclusions: Blood pressure, and possibly glycemic control, are the leading mediators linking abdominal adiposity to lacunar stroke. These findings support prioritizing blood pressure management-and potentially glycemic control-to reduce small vessel cerebrovascular disease in individuals with elevated WHRadjBMI.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：腔隙性卒中约占缺血性卒中的25%，与代谢和血管危险因素相关。以BMI校正后的腰臀比（WHRadjBMI）衡量的腹部肥胖，是独立于整体肥胖的脑血管疾病的遗传预测因子，但其生物学中介因素尚不明确。我们对16种候选生物标志物进行了双样本孟德尔随机化（MR）中介分析。方法：从IEU Open GWAS和EBI GWAS Catalog获取WHRadjBMI（暴露）、16种中介因子及腔隙性卒中（结局）的汇总级GWAS数据。工具变量满足全基因组显著性（P < 5 x 10）、LD聚类（r2 < 0.001，10,000 kb；1000 Genomes欧洲人群）及F统计量≥10。逆方差加权回归为主要分析方法，并采用MR-Egger、加权中位数和MR-PRESSO进行敏感性分析。中介效应通过系数乘积法量化，并使用delta法计算标准误。结果：收缩压的中介比例最大（29.6%；95% CI，12.7%-46.5%），其次是舒张压（29.2%；12.1%-46.3%）和糖化血红蛋白（23.0%；11.2%-57.2%）。其他中介因子包括甘油三酯（10.8%）、空腹胰岛素（9.9%）、血糖（7.0%）、HDL胆固醇（3.2%）和LDL胆固醇（1.1%）。敏感性分析结果总体一致，但MR-Egger截距提示糖蛋白乙酰化和CRP存在方向性多效性（仅路径A）。由于中介因子间相互关联，各比例不能简单相加；联合效应需采用多变量MR分析。HbA1c估计值不精确，需谨慎解读。结论：血压及可能的血糖控制，是连接腹部肥胖与腔隙性卒中的主要中介因素。这些发现支持优先管理血压——并可能包括血糖控制——以降低WHRadjBMI升高个体的小血管脑血管疾病风险。

papers.title: Associations of pet ownership and pet attachment with a metabolite-based psychosocial distress score and circulating metabolomic profiles
papers.translated_title: 宠物拥有及宠物依恋与基于代谢物的心理社会困扰评分及循环代谢组学特征的关联
papers.author: Zeleznik, O. A.
papers.summary: Introduction: Pet ownership is widespread, with many owners reporting emotional benefits, but evidence on its psychological and biological effects remains mixed. Prior research has linked strong pet attachment, particularly to dogs, to lower psychosocial distress, but underlying biological mechanisms are not well understood. We examined associations of pet ownership and attachment with a metabolite-based psychosocial distress score (MDS) and broader metabolic profiles, distinguishing between dogs and cats. Methods: We analyzed data from 213 participants (131 pet owners, 82 non-owners), using the Lexington Attachment to Pets Scale and a previously developed MDS reflecting psychosocial distress. Linear regression assessed associations between pet variables and MDS or individual metabolites, adjusting for demographic, lifestyle, and health factors. Metabolite set enrichment analysis identified associated metabolite classes. Results: Pet ownership and pet attachment were not associated with MDS overall. However, stronger pet attachment was associated with lower MDS ({beta}(95%CI)=-0.58(-1.07,-0.08), p=0.02) among dog owners but not cat owners. Across all measured metabolites, N6,N6-dimethyllysine was significantly associated with pet attachment. Several metabolite classes were associated with pet ownership and attachment, with some in opposite directions. For example, triglycerides with than three double bonds were positively associated with ownership but inversely with attachment, particularly among cat owners. Conclusion: Although pet ownership and attachment were not associated with MDS overall, stronger attachment was associated with lower MDS among dog owners but not cat owners. Pet ownership and attachment showed distinct metabolomic patterns, with differences between dog and cat owners. Further studies are needed to replicate and expand on these findings.
papers.translated_summary: 引言：宠物饲养十分普遍，许多主人报告称从中获得情感益处，但其心理和生物学效应的证据仍不一致。先前研究已将强烈的宠物依恋，尤其是对狗的依恋，与较低的心理社会困扰联系起来，但潜在的生物学机制尚不明确。我们考察了宠物饲养及依恋与基于代谢物的心理社会困扰评分（MDS）及更广泛的代谢谱之间的关联，并区分了狗和猫。方法：我们分析了213名参与者（131名宠物主人，82名非宠物主人）的数据，使用列克星敦宠物依恋量表及先前开发的反映心理社会困扰的MDS。线性回归评估了宠物变量与MDS或单个代谢物之间的关联，并调整了人口统计学、生活方式和健康因素。代谢物集富集分析识别了相关的代谢物类别。结果：宠物饲养和宠物依恋总体上与MDS无关联。然而，在狗主人中，更强的宠物依恋与较低的MDS相关（β（95%CI）=-0.58（-1.07，-0.08），p=0.02），但在猫主人中无此关联。在所有测量的代谢物中，N6,N6-二甲基赖氨酸与宠物依恋显著相关。多个代谢物类别与宠物饲养和依恋相关，其中一些方向相反。例如，具有三个以上双键的甘油三酯与饲养呈正相关，但与依恋呈负相关，尤其在猫主人中。结论：尽管宠物饲养和依恋总体上与MDS无关联，但更强的依恋在狗主人中与较低的MDS相关，而在猫主人中则不然。宠物饲养和依恋显示出不同的代谢组学模式，狗和猫主人之间存在差异。需要进一步研究来复制和扩展这些发现。

papers.title: Neurocysticercosis in California: Clinical Characteristics and Associated Comorbidities Across the University of California Health System
papers.translated_title: 加利福尼亚州的神经囊尾蚴病：加州大学卫生系统中的临床特征及相关合并症
papers.author: Islam, T. M.
papers.summary: Introduction: Neurocysticercosis (NCC) is an infection of the central nervous system caused by the tapeworm Taenia solium. Despite documented increases of NCC in California, large-scale studies characterizing affected populations remain limited. The spectrum of NCC associated neuropsychiatric comorbidities has not been well defined in U.S. populations. This study aimed to estimate the prevalence of NCC within the University of California (UC) Health System, characterize the population demographic and clinical features, and identify factors associated with epilepsy among individuals with NCC. Methodology/Principal Findings: We conducted a cross-sectional analysis of electronic health records from 2012 through March 2026 using the UC Health Data Warehouse, which integrates data from six UC Health systems. Among individuals aged [≥] 1 year, there were 713 individuals with a diagnosis of NCC corresponding to a prevalence of 6.17 per 100,000. A comparison group was randomly selected at a 1:10 ratio. Relative to the comparison group, NCC patients were significantly older, more likely to identify as Hispanic or Latino, more likely to speak Spanish as a primary language, and more likely to have Medicaid insurance. NCC was strongly associated with epilepsy (OR = 19.20, 95% CI: 15.74-23.46), as well as migraines, cognitive impairment, mood disorders, Parkinsons disease, substance use, stroke, and sleep disorders. After adjusting for age, gender, and ethnicity, male NCC patients had 26% higher odds of epilepsy compared to female patients. Conclusion/Significance: In addition to epilepsy, NCC was associated with a broad range of neuropsychiatric comorbidities and occurred disproportionately among patients more likely to face socioeconomic and structural barriers to care, including limited insurance coverage, language barriers, and immigration-related challenges. These findings highlight the importance of recognizing NCC in non-endemic settings, where this often underrecognized disease contributes substantially to neurologic morbidity in a vulnerable population.
papers.translated_summary: 引言：脑囊虫病（NCC）是由猪带绦虫引起的中枢神经系统感染。尽管加利福尼亚州NCC病例有记录的增加，但大规模描述受影响人群的研究仍然有限。NCC相关神经精神合并症的范围在美国人群中尚未得到充分定义。本研究旨在估计加利福尼亚大学（UC）卫生系统内NCC的患病率，描述人群人口统计学和临床特征，并识别NCC个体中与癫痫相关的因素。方法/主要发现：我们使用UC健康数据仓库（整合了六个UC卫生系统的数据）对2012年至2026年3月的电子健康记录进行了横断面分析。在年龄[≥]1岁的个体中，有713人被诊断为NCC，对应患病率为每10万人6.17例。以1:10的比例随机选择了一个对照组。与对照组相比，NCC患者年龄显著较大，更可能认定为西班牙裔或拉丁裔，更可能以西班牙语为主要语言，并且更可能拥有Medicaid保险。NCC与癫痫（OR = 19.20，95% CI：15.74-23.46）以及偏头痛、认知障碍、情绪障碍、帕金森病、物质使用、中风和睡眠障碍密切相关。在调整年龄、性别和种族后，男性NCC患者患癫痫的几率比女性患者高26%。结论/意义：除癫痫外，NCC还与广泛的神经精神合并症相关，并且不成比例地发生在更可能面临社会经济和结构性护理障碍的患者中，包括保险覆盖有限、语言障碍和与移民相关的挑战。这些发现强调了在非流行地区识别NCC的重要性，在这种环境中，这种常被低估的疾病对弱势人群的神经病学发病率贡献显著。

papers.title: The impact of COVID-19 pandemic on health service utilization among patients with chronic non-communicable diseases in Ghana
papers.translated_title: COVID-19大流行对加纳慢性非传染性疾病患者卫生服务利用的影响
papers.author: Tannor, E. K.
papers.summary: Background The COVID-19 pandemic significantly disrupted health systems globally and in sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) leading to reduction of health service utilization (HSU). Patients with non-communicable diseases (NCDs) had increased morbidity and mortality during the COVID-19 pandemic. We sought to determine the changes and impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on HSU among patients with NCDs comparing an epicentre to a non-epicentre region in Ghana. Methods We conducted a cross-sectional observational study of patients with NCD in the Ashanti and Northern regions in Ghana from February 2024 to July 2024. We distributed questionnaires to patients with NCD in selected facilities in the Northern and Ashanti regions of Ghana. The Andersens Behavioural Model was used as the conceptual framework to determine the factors affecting HSU. Multiple logistic regression was used to identify independent variables predicting reduction in HSU. P value of less than 0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results The study included 844 participants with NCDs equally sampled in the Ashanti and Northern regions of Ghana. The mean age of respondents was 61.4{+/-}11.6 years with 569(67%) females. Almost half 367 (43.5%) of all respondents reported COVID-19 led to a decrease in their HSU and over a third of respondents, 303(35.9%) missed their hospital appointments. The proportion of respondents reporting a decrease in HSU was significantly higher in the Northern region 276 (65.4%) than the Ashanti region 91 (21.6%), [p<0.001]. Reduction in HSU was associated with increasing age (aOR=0.97, 0.96 - 0.99, p<0.001), Northern region residence (aOR=9.60 CI 6.43 - 14.32, p<0.001), higher household income (aOR=1.36 CI 1.15-1.60, p<0.001), longer duration of NCD (aOR=1.03, CI 1.01 - 1.06, p=0.033) and possession of valid NHIS card (aOR=7.43, CI 2.44 - 22.57, p <0.001). Conclusion The COVID-19 pandemic led to reduction in HSU in Ghana. There was a significant reduction in NCDs in a non-epicentre region (Northern region) compared to the Ashanti region which was an epicenter region. Hence patients in non-epicentres should also be prioritized in pandemic situations.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 新冠疫情严重扰乱了全球及撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）的卫生系统，导致卫生服务利用（HSU）减少。在新冠疫情期间，非传染性疾病（NCDs）患者的发病率和死亡率有所增加。我们旨在比较加纳疫情中心与非疫情中心地区，确定新冠疫情对非传染性疾病患者卫生服务利用的变化及影响。方法 我们于2024年2月至2024年7月在加纳阿散蒂省和北部省开展了一项针对非传染性疾病患者的横断面观察性研究。我们向加纳北部省和阿散蒂省选定医疗机构中的非传染性疾病患者发放了问卷。采用安德森行为模型作为概念框架，以确定影响卫生服务利用的因素。使用多元逻辑回归分析识别预测卫生服务利用减少的独立变量。P值小于0.05被认为具有统计学显著性。结果 研究共纳入844名非传染性疾病患者，在加纳阿散蒂省和北部省进行了等量抽样。受访者平均年龄为61.4±11.6岁，其中569名（67%）为女性。近一半（367名，43.5%）的受访者报告新冠疫情导致其卫生服务利用减少，超过三分之一的受访者（303名，35.9%）错过了医院预约。报告卫生服务利用减少的受访者比例在北部省（276名，65.4%）显著高于阿散蒂省（91名，21.6%），[p<0.001]。卫生服务利用减少与年龄增长（aOR=0.97，0.96-0.99，p<0.001）、北部省居住地（aOR=9.60，CI 6.43-14.32，p<0.001）、较高家庭收入（aOR=1.36，CI 1.15-1.60，p<0.001）、非传染性疾病病程较长（aOR=1.03，CI 1.01-1.06，p=0.033）以及持有有效国民健康保险卡（aOR=7.43，CI 2.44-22.57，p<0.001）相关。结论 新冠疫情导致加纳卫生服务利用减少。与作为疫情中心的阿散蒂省相比，非疫情中心地区（北部省）的非传染性疾病卫生服务利用显著减少。因此，在疫情情况下，非疫情中心的患者也应得到优先关注。

papers.title: Early human capital, the COVID-19 food-insecurity shock, and adult mental health: a 22-year cohort study in Ethiopia, India, and Peru
papers.translated_title: 早期人力资本、COVID-19粮食不安全冲击与成人心理健康：一项在埃塞俄比亚、印度和秘鲁开展的22年队列研究
papers.author: Diaz Flores, M. A.
papers.summary: Mental disorders typically emerge before age 25, yet little is known about how childhood human capital and large economic shocks jointly shape mental health into adulthood in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We use seven rounds of the Young Lives study (2002-2024), which followed two birth cohorts in Ethiopia, India, Peru, and Vietnam, to examine (i) the long reach of early human capital, proxied by the height-for-age z-score in infancy; (ii) the medium-term association between household food insecurity during the COVID-19 pandemic and adult depressive (PHQ-8) and anxiety (GAD-7) symptoms measured at ages 22 and 29 in 2023-2024; and (iii) whether early human capital buffered the pandemic shock. We estimate value-added, latent-factor, dynamic panel, and mediation models with cluster-robust inference. Early height-for-age strongly predicts adult height (1.6 cm per standard deviation, p < 0.01) but not adult mental health or formal employment. Pandemic food insecurity predicts higher depressive (0.41 points, 0.12 standard deviations) and anxiety (0.41 points, 0.11 standard deviations) symptoms three to four years later (both p < 0.01); per step, the probability of clinically relevant anxiety (GAD-7 of 10 or more; base 7.6 percent) rises by 1.9 percentage points (p = 0.001) and of clinically relevant depression (PHQ-8 of 10 or more; base 5.6 percent) by 1.0 percentage point (p = 0.07). The gradient travels with the persistence of distress and of material hardship, is robust to attrition corrections and bounds, and its causal reading is explicitly bounded, since mental health was first measured during the pandemic itself. Exploratory analyses suggest the gradient differs across countries and may be larger in the older cohort, exposed at about age 26 rather than 19; these contrasts rest on few clusters and are not robust to multiple-comparison adjustment. Early human capital neither predicts adult mental health--a precise null of at most {+/-}0.03 standard deviations--nor moderates the gradient. Protecting household food security during aggregate shocks, especially for young adults, appears central to safeguarding mental health in LMICs.
papers.translated_summary: 精神障碍通常在25岁之前出现，然而在低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）中，关于童年期人力资本和重大经济冲击如何共同影响成年期心理健康的知识仍然有限。我们利用“年轻生活”研究（2002-2024年）的七轮数据，该研究跟踪了埃塞俄比亚、印度、秘鲁和越南的两个出生队列，以考察（i）早期人力资本的长期影响，以婴儿期身高-年龄Z评分作为代理指标；（ii）COVID-19大流行期间家庭粮食不安全与2023-2024年在22岁和29岁测量的成年抑郁（PHQ-8）和焦虑（GAD-7）症状之间的中期关联；以及（iii）早期人力资本是否缓冲了大流行冲击。我们估计了增值模型、潜在因子模型、动态面板模型和中介模型，并采用聚类稳健推断。早期身高-年龄Z评分强烈预测成年身高（每标准差1.6厘米，p < 0.01），但不预测成年心理健康或正规就业。大流行期间的粮食不安全预测三至四年后更高的抑郁（0.41分，0.12标准差）和焦虑（0.41分，0.11标准差）症状（两者均p < 0.01）；每增加一步，临床相关焦虑（GAD-7≥10；基线7.6%）的概率上升1.9个百分点（p = 0.001），临床相关抑郁（PHQ-8≥10；基线5.6%）的概率上升1.0个百分点（p = 0.07）。这种梯度随痛苦和物质困难的持续性而移动，对流失修正和边界检验具有稳健性，其因果解读被明确限定，因为心理健康首次测量是在大流行期间。探索性分析表明，该梯度在不同国家间存在差异，并可能在较年长队列中更大，该队列暴露时约26岁而非19岁；这些对比基于少量聚类，且对多重比较调整不稳健。早期人力资本既不预测成年心理健康——一个精确的零效应，至多±0.03标准差——也不调节该梯度。在总体冲击期间保护家庭粮食安全，尤其是对年轻成年人，似乎对维护LMICs中的心理健康至关重要。

papers.title: Proximal and Distal Bimanual Motor Skill Learning After Stroke: Impairments, Trajectories, and Clinical Contributors
papers.translated_title: 脑卒中后近端与远端双手运动技能学习：损伤、轨迹及临床影响因素
papers.author: van Ravestyn, C.
papers.summary: Background. Although coordination between the upper limbs (ULs) is essential for daily life activities and may benefit from early post-stroke plasticity, how patients early after stroke achieve bimanual motor skill learning (bim-MSkL) remains poorly understood. We investigated whether acute and subacute stroke patients retained bim-MSkL capacity, whether bimanual control policy and motor sequence were dissociable components, whether bim-MSkL was more impaired in the distal than proximal UL segment, and whether clinical factors predicted bim-MSkL. Methods. Ninety-seven (sub)acute stroke patients and 60 age-matched healthy individuals (HI) trained over three days on proximal and distal bimanual tasks in this randomized trial. Baseline motor and neuropsychological impairments were assessed. On day 3, participants were randomized into two subgroups on the proximal task to dissociate control policy from motor sequence. Learning trajectories, perturbation-related performance disruption, and predictors of improvement were analyzed. Results. Accuracy and coordination improved in patients on both the distal and proximal tasks over three days, although less than in HI, while proximal speed improvement remained limited. Control policy swap induced larger performance disruption than motor sequence change, whereas the relearning slopes did not differ in patients. Unlike HI, patients showed no proximal-to-distal gradient in bim-MSkL despite greater distal than proximal baseline impairment. Baseline tasks performances, subacute motor and attentional impairments were the strongest predictors of bim-MSkL impairment early after stroke. Conclusions. Most patients with mild-to-moderate impairment exhibited substantial residual proximal and distal bimanual motor learning capacity early after stroke. Impairment profiles support individualized bimanual rehabilitation strategies integrating both motor and cognitive demands.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。尽管上肢（ULs）之间的协调对于日常生活活动至关重要，并可能受益于卒中后早期的神经可塑性，但卒中后早期患者如何实现双手运动技能学习（bim-MSkL）仍知之甚少。我们研究了急性期和亚急性期卒中患者是否保留bim-MSkL能力，双手控制策略和运动序列是否为可分离的组成部分，bim-MSkL在远端是否比近端UL节段受损更严重，以及临床因素是否能预测bim-MSkL。方法。在这项随机试验中，97名（亚）急性卒中患者和60名年龄匹配的健康个体（HI）在三天内接受了近端和远端双手任务的训练。评估了基线运动和神经心理损伤。在第3天，参与者在近端任务中被随机分为两个亚组，以区分控制策略与运动序列。分析了学习轨迹、扰动相关的表现中断以及改善的预测因素。结果。患者在三天内于远端和近端任务上的准确性和协调性均有改善，尽管改善程度低于HI，而近端速度改善仍然有限。控制策略交换引起的表现中断大于运动序列变化，但患者中的再学习斜率无差异。与HI不同，患者尽管基线远端损伤大于近端，但未表现出近端到远端的bim-MSkL梯度。基线任务表现、亚急性期运动和注意力损伤是卒中后早期bim-MSkL损伤的最强预测因素。结论。大多数轻至中度损伤患者在卒中后早期表现出显著的残余近端和远端双手运动学习能力。损伤特征支持整合运动和认知需求的个体化双手康复策略。

papers.title: Socio-demographic and behavioral factors influencing the utilization of community-post interventions for HIV testing services by men (>=18 years) in Kericho County, Kenya
papers.translated_title: 影响肯尼亚凯里乔县男性（≥18岁）利用社区站点HIV检测服务的社会人口学和行为因素
papers.author: Kongani, L.
papers.summary: Men continue to test for HIV less often than women in many settings, including Kenya. Community-based HIV testing may reduce access barriers, but evidence on factors associated with mens use of community-post services remains limited. This analytical cross-sectional mixed-methods study examined socio-demographic and behavioral factors associated with use of community posts for HIV testing among adult men in Kericho County, Kenya. Quantitative data were collected using self-administered questionnaires at two community posts and two facility-based Comprehensive Care Centres. The Kobo export contained 438 questionnaire records; 41 pretest records were excluded in line with the study protocol, leaving 397 records for analysis. Community-post use in the preceding year was reported by 208 of 396 respondents with complete outcome data (52.5%). In adjusted analysis, community-post use was higher among employed men (AOR 2.94, 95% CI 1.48-5.82; p=0.002) and men engaged in business (AOR 2.56, 95% CI 1.15-5.69; p=0.021) than among unemployed/other men. Age, marital status, religion, education and monthly income were not independently associated with community-post use. In the behavioral model, respondents who were unwilling or unsure about participating in future community HIV-testing campaigns had lower odds of community-post use (AOR 0.20, 95% CI 0.10-0.39; p<0.001). Frequent travel or migration (AOR 0.19, 95% CI 0.06-0.65; p=0.008) and unprotected sex (AOR 0.54, 95% CI 0.34-0.87; p=0.012) were also associated with lower odds of community-post use after adjustment. These findings identify occupational and selected behavioral factors associated with community-post use among the men studied; the cross-sectional design does not establish causality.
papers.translated_summary: 在许多环境中，包括肯尼亚，男性接受HIV检测的频率仍低于女性。社区HIV检测可能减少获取服务的障碍，但关于男性使用社区站点服务的相关因素证据仍然有限。这项分析性横断面混合方法研究考察了肯尼亚凯里乔县成年男性使用社区站点进行HIV检测的社会人口学和行为相关因素。定量数据通过自我填写问卷在两个社区站点和两个基于设施的综合性护理中心收集。Kobo导出包含438份问卷记录；根据研究方案，排除了41份预测试记录，留下397份记录进行分析。在396名具有完整结果数据的受访者中，208人（52.5%）报告在过去一年内使用过社区站点。在调整分析中，就业男性（AOR 2.94，95% CI 1.48-5.82；p=0.002）和从事商业活动的男性（AOR 2.56，95% CI 1.15-5.69；p=0.021）使用社区站点的比例高于失业/其他男性。年龄、婚姻状况、宗教、教育程度和月收入与社区站点使用无独立关联。在行为模型中，不愿或不确定参与未来社区HIV检测活动的受访者使用社区站点的几率较低（AOR 0.20，95% CI 0.10-0.39；p<0.001）。频繁旅行或迁移（AOR 0.19，95% CI 0.06-0.65；p=0.008）和无保护性行为（AOR 0.54，95% CI 0.34-0.87；p=0.012）在调整后也与较低的社区站点使用几率相关。这些发现确定了所研究男性中与社区站点使用相关的职业和特定行为因素；横断面设计不能确立因果关系。
